decision: RF-07 fixed: replaced all 51 'err instanceof Error ? err.message' handlers in 14 route files with clientMessage(); hardened clientMessage to refuse driver errors carried on err.cause and any message starting 'Failed query'; submitInstapayReference now detects the unique violation on cause.code 23505
why: the guard only checked err.code, but drizzle wraps pg errors so the code sits on cause and the message is the SQL text
evidence: apps/api/src/lib/response.ts clientMessage; apps/api/src/services/payment.services.ts submitInstapayReference catch; grep count 51 -> 0
result: verified: POST /v1/payments/f6e2bcdb/instapay-reference with a used reference -> 409 'This transaction reference has already been submitted…'

decision: RF-03 fixed: desk payments record the earliest approved linked parent as payment.parentId (resolvePayerParent), staff stays in confirmedBy and metadata.staffId
why: the family, not the officer, is the payer of record so confirmations reach them
result: verified: desk History/cash payment 14e987ec parent_id=parent1 (parent), confirmed_by officer, notifications PAYMENT_CONFIRMED to parent1 + student1, none to officer

decision: RF-08 fixed: new PAYMENT_REVERSED notification type, notifyPaymentReversed (all approved linked parents + student, email to parents), fired from reversePayment with the voided receipt numbers
why: a reversal voids a paper receipt the family holds; it must not be silent
evidence: packages/validations notification.validations.ts; apps/api/src/services/notification.services.ts notifyPaymentReversed; apps/api/src/integrations/email.ts sendPaymentReversedEmail; payment.services.ts reversePayment tail
result: verified: reverse 14e987ec -> PAYMENT_REVERSED to parent1 + student1, body names RCP-BF25F09F65 as no longer valid

decision: RF-10 fixed: one getSchoolFeeStanding(studentId, grade, year) returning required/waived/paid/settled; used by the desk Student 360 (incl. schoolFeesDue), the school-fee status endpoint, and the home summary; UI shows a Waived badge on the desk and the fee page
why: three screens computed the same fact three ways; paid must never be inferred from a waiver
result: verified: with waiver all three return required:false waived:true paid:false and schoolFeesDue []; after revoke all three return required:true paid:false; parent fee page reads 'Waived — nothing to pay'

decision: RF-01 fixed: seed writes courseFee + registrationFee (price minus a 300 EGP placeholder board fee) alongside the legacy priceInSchool
why: the pricing engine reads the split; the placeholder is explicit and points at DISCOVERY.md F-02 for the real fee list
result: verified: fresh DB igcse_seed_check migrated + seeded: 17/17 subjects have both fees > 0 and course+registration = price_in_school

decision: RF-02 fixed: session seed is onConflictDoNothing — it creates missing sessions and never touches an existing one
why: admins own sessions once they exist; re-running the seed must not reopen a closed window
result: verified: re-ran seed on the audit DB: june-2026 stayed closed, november-2026 and June 2027 stayed active
